name: sabi
description: SABI — a voice-first digital literacy platform for elderly Nigerians

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sabi/api" "npm run dev -w @sabi/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sabi/api && npm run typecheck -w @sabi/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run content:validate && npm run scam:eval && npm run voice:eval && npm run security:check && npm run build
